name: Aether Industries Ltd.
about: Aether Industries Limited produces and sells advanced intermediates and specialty chemicals in India and internationally. It provides large-scale manufacturing, contract research and manufacturing services, as well as contract/exclusive manufacturing services. The company serves its products to the chemical industry, including multinational, regional, and local companies in the pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, materials science, coatings, photography, additives, and oil and gas industries. It also exports its products. The company collaborate with Dow Chemical International Private Limited to manufactures silicone technology development in India. Aether Industries Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Surat, India.

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~38% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~20% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 94 vs sector median 32; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 30, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 20% a year while PE moved 93 → 94.
